sentences.zh: 更进一步说，越来越多的效果图展示了建筑本身上就有大树和灌木，

sentences.en: And to take it a step further, more and more renderings feature big trees and shrubs actually on buildings themselves,
sentences.zh: 就像摩天大楼上的垂直森林一样。

sentences.en: like whole vertical forests on skyscrapers.
sentences.zh: 库尔特·科尔斯塔德让我注意到了这个趋势，他现在就在演播室里和我讨论这个问题。

sentences.en: And Kurt Kolstad was the person who made me aware of this trend, and he's in the studio with me to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 那么，你是什么时候第一次注意到效果图里的摩天大楼被树木覆盖的？

sentences.en: So, when did you first notice trees just overrunning skyscrapers and renderings?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，十年前我在建筑学院时，这绝对不是一种潮流。

sentences.en: I mean, it definitely wasn't a thing when I was in architecture school a decade ago.
sentences.zh: 我想这应该是最近才出现的。

sentences.en: I would say it was more recent than that.
sentences.zh: 在2010年代，我开始注意到越来越多这种日益荒谬的效果图，

sentences.en: During the 2010s, I started to notice more and more of these increasingly absurd renderings
sentences.zh: 树木几乎无处不在，而且它们看起来很美，正处于盛开期。

sentences.en: where the trees were just kind of everywhere, and they were beautiful and in bloom.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，建筑师在效果图上推陈出新有着悠久的传统。

sentences.en: And, you know, architects have a long tradition of kind of pushing the edges with their renderings.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You'll see, like, a lot of really clean lines.
sentences.zh: 你会看到很多非常简洁的线条。

sentences.en: You might not see the ugly railings on balconies, the things that are going to be there in the end.
sentences.zh: 你可能看不到阳台上那些丑陋的栏杆，那些最终会出现在那里的东西。

sentences.en: But this kind of, like, we're just going to put greenery on everything and just assume that's fine and people will buy that.
sentences.zh: 但这种做法，就像是我们打算在所有地方都种上绿植，然后就想当然地认为这样很好，人们也会买账。

sentences.en: I mean, it just kind of got to the point of being absurd.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这已经到了荒谬的地步。

sentences.en: Is it really this idea of selling an image, or do you think it's, like, a little bit of this greenwashing association that it feels environmental to have trees on buildings?
sentences.zh: 这真的是为了兜售一种形象，还是你认为这多少带点“漂绿”的意味，让人觉得在建筑上种树就很有环保感？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，确实。

sentences.en: I mean, that's the great thing about it, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这正是它的绝妙之处，对吧？

sentences.en: You can sort of sell it to environmentalists, like, look how literally green our building is.
sentences.zh: 你可以把它卖给环保主义者，比如，看看我们的建筑在字面意义上有多“绿”。

sentences.en: And, of course, you can sell it to people because they're like, wow, I'm going to be on the 24th floor, but I'm still going to have this kind of, like,
sentences.zh: 当然，你也可以把它卖给普通人，因为他们会觉得，哇，我住在24楼，却依然能拥有这种，

sentences.en: lush greenery surrounding me.
sentences.zh: 环绕着我的郁郁葱葱的绿植。

sentences.en: There's something to that, too, right?
sentences.zh: 这也有一定的道理，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, like, you can help bolster ecosysteMs.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你可以帮助加强生态系统。

sentences.en: You can help filter air.
sentences.zh: 你可以帮助过滤空气。

sentences.en: You can provide some shade, at least for the residents.
sentences.zh: 你至少可以为居民提供一些遮荫。

sentences.en: There are arguments for putting greenery up high.
sentences.zh: 在高处种植绿植是有其理由的。

sentences.en: The problem in general is just that people don't realize how challenging it is.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，问题在于人们没有意识到这有多么困难。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错。

sentences.en: And so what are the challenges of putting really big greenery on a building?
sentences.zh: 那么，在建筑上种植大型绿植有哪些挑战呢？

sentences.en: So the kind of number one challenge of this is just being able to support that greenery physically, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，这方面首要的挑战就是如何在物理上支撑这些绿植，对吧？

sentences.en: So, like, trees are heavy.
sentences.zh: 比如，树木很重。

sentences.en: Yeah, trees are heavy.
sentences.zh: 是的，树木很重。

sentences.en: And, like, architects have to design for both active and passive loads.
sentences.zh: 而且，建筑师必须同时设计活荷载和静荷载。

sentences.en: Active loads being things like people and passive loads being, like, you know, snowfall.
sentences.zh: 活荷载是指人这类东西，而静荷载是指，你知道的，积雪之类的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And basically putting, like, these big, heavy trees can, like, double or triple the passive load requirements.
sentences.zh: 基本上，放置这些又大又重的树木，可能会使静荷载要求增加两到三倍。

sentences.en: So you end up having to bring in all this extra structure.
sentences.zh: 所以你最终不得不引入所有这些额外的结构。

sentences.en: And on top of that, that's not just structure to support the trees.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，这不仅仅是为了支撑树木的结构。

sentences.en: That's also structure to support two or three feet of soil to support the tree.
sentences.zh: 这还是为了支撑两三英尺厚的土壤以供养树木的结构。

sentences.en: I mean, it just kind of stacks.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这简直是层层叠加。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then there are irrigation systeMs.
sentences.zh: 然后还有灌溉系统。

sentences.en: There's the hoisting up of these things in the first place.
sentences.zh: 首先还得把这些东西吊装上去。

sentences.en: I mean, the list is long.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，清单很长。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Is it only passive?
sentences.zh: 只有静荷载吗？

sentences.en: I mean, it strikes me that trees at high altitude are actually kind of active because they blow in the wind and they move.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我感觉高海拔地区的树木实际上是“活”的，因为它们会在风中摇曳和移动。

sentences.en: And is that something you have to account for?
sentences.zh: 这是你必须考虑的问题吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I don't know if they're doing sort of lateral load calculations for that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们是否为此做了侧向荷载计算。

sentences.en: But definitely the impact of wind on these things is a factor, right?
sentences.zh: 但风对这些东西的影响绝对是一个因素，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, so you get these things up high.
sentences.zh: 比如，你把这些东西放在高处。

sentences.en: Trees like forests for a reason, right?
sentences.zh: 树木喜欢森林是有原因的，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, they like to be surrounded by other trees.
sentences.zh: 它们喜欢被其他树木环绕。

sentences.en: And other trees help keep them from, like, blowing down.
sentences.zh: 而其他树木有助于防止它们被风吹倒。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the high winds at higher altitudes can interrupt photosynthetic processes and just kind of cause different issues for greenery that, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以高海拔地区的强风会干扰光合作用，并给那些，你知道的，

sentences.en: wasn't born and bred for that environment.
sentences.zh: 并非为那种环境而生、而培育的绿植带来各种问题。

sentences.en: It wasn't meant to be on a big building by itself.
sentences.zh: 它们本不该孤零零地待在一栋大楼上。

sentences.en: And on top of that, too, in a lot of these towers, they show kind of equal greenery on all sides.
sentences.zh: 而且最重要的是，在许多这类塔楼中，它们展示的绿植在各个侧面看起来都是一样的。

sentences.en: And that looks lovely.
sentences.zh: 那看起来很美。

sentences.en: Reality works differently.
sentences.zh: 现实情况却并非如此。

sentences.en: Like, the sun rises, it sets.
sentences.zh: 比如，太阳升起又落下。

sentences.en: And so if you've got a building, for example, with a north-facing facade, you might have trees that never see any sunlight.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你有一栋建筑，例如，北向的立面，你可能会有永远见不到阳光的树木。

sentences.en: So this kind of equal treatment on all sides makes it seem a little artificial and not very sustainable.
sentences.zh: 因此，这种对所有侧面一视同仁的做法显得有些虚假，也不太可持续。

sentences.en: So the greenery looks environmental.
sentences.zh: 所以绿植看起来很环保。

sentences.en: But the first problem is you have to put all these extra materials, concrete and steel, to make this greenery viable on top of a big building.
sentences.zh: 但第一个问题是，你必须投入所有这些额外的材料，混凝土和钢材，才能让这些绿植在大楼顶部存活。

sentences.en: So that's sort of one of the drawbacks of if any of this was ever a reality.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果这一切真的成为现实，这就是其中的一个弊端。

sentences.en: I think the fundamental thing is most of the time it isn't a reality.
sentences.zh: 我认为根本问题在于，大多数时候这根本不是现实。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错。

sentences.en: A lot of these don't get built, right?
sentences.zh: 很多这样的项目根本没建成，对吧？

sentences.en: They're sort of concept renderings that kind of get people interested in an architecture firm, you know, designed for competitions and not for being built.
sentences.zh: 它们只是概念渲染图，用来吸引人们对某家建筑事务所的兴趣，你知道的，是为竞赛设计的，而不是为了建造的。

sentences.en: Some do get built with sort of various degrees of success and failure.
sentences.zh: 有些确实建成了，但成功和失败的程度各不相同。

sentences.en: And one of the classic examples of one of these that really did get built is called the Vertical ForeSt.
sentences.zh: 其中一个真正建成的经典例子被称为“垂直森林”。

sentences.en: And it's in Milan.
sentences.zh: 它位于米兰。

sentences.en: And it's a pair of towers.
sentences.zh: 那是一对双子塔。

sentences.en: They meet a lot of the criteria we've been talking about.
sentences.zh: 它们符合我们一直在讨论的许多标准。

sentences.en: They essentially have kind of equal greenery on all sides.
sentences.zh: 它们基本上在各个侧面都有相当均匀的绿植。

sentences.en: It's really lush.
sentences.zh: 它确实非常茂盛。

sentences.en: They made these things, right?
sentences.zh: 他们把这些东西做出来了，对吧？

sentences.en: And they hoisted the trees up.
sentences.zh: 而且他们把树吊了上去。

sentences.en: And it doesn't look bad.
sentences.zh: 看起来也不错。

sentences.en: And it seems to be sort of working.
sentences.zh: 而且似乎确实在起作用。

sentences.en: But, you know, it encountered a lot of issues, too, in construction.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，它在施工过程中也遇到了很多问题。

sentences.en: There were a lot of construction delays and sort of figuring out how are we going to irrigate these things and accommodate these loads.
sentences.zh: 有很多施工延误，还要想办法如何灌溉这些东西，以及如何应对这些荷载。

sentences.en: So some of those are predictable.
sentences.zh: 所以其中一些是可以预见的。

sentences.en: And some of those are kind of specific to the fact that this building had to do more than a lot of buildings have to do.
sentences.zh: 而另一些则是因为这栋建筑必须承担比许多建筑更多的工作。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错。

sentences.en: And that same firm has since gone on to design other examples for other cities.
sentences.zh: 而同一家事务所此后又为其他城市设计了其他例子。

sentences.en: They all kind of look the same.
sentences.zh: 它们看起来都差不多。

sentences.en: They sort of look like, hey, we've got this model and we're going to kind of apply it in all these different places.
sentences.zh: 它们看起来就像是，嘿，我们有这个模型，我们要把它应用到所有这些不同的地方。

sentences.en: But one of the things that always cracks me up when I'm looking at their renderings is you'll see all these trees up on the sides of the buildings and then they'll depict the plaza surrounding it below.
sentences.zh: 但每当我看到他们的渲染图时，有一件事总是让我发笑，那就是你会看到建筑侧面全是树，然后他们会描绘下方环绕的广场。

sentences.en: And there'll be like a couple of trees.
sentences.zh: 那里却只有几棵树。

sentences.en: And I can't help but think, you know, if you really want to go all green, the easiest way to do that would be to just add more trees on the ground.
sentences.zh: 我不禁在想，你知道，如果你真的想追求全绿，最简单的方法就是在地面上多加些树。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so it makes you wonder, like, what is really the purpose?
sentences.zh: 所以这让你怀疑，真正的目的是什么？

sentences.en: Is it aesthetic?
sentences.zh: 是为了美观吗？

sentences.en: Is it just for the residents?
sentences.zh: 只是为了居民吗？

sentences.en: I mean, if they were trying to sort of serve the public good, filter air, do all these things, they could just really pack in the greenery on the space below.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果他们真的想服务于公共利益，过滤空气，做所有这些事情，他们完全可以在下面的空间里种满绿植。

sentences.en: And it would be potentially a really nice amenity.
sentences.zh: 那可能会是一个非常好的便利设施。

sentences.en: That's one of the interesting side effects that actually you made me aware of as well, which is like, you know, putting trees on a building is like on the vanguard of architecture.
sentences.zh: 这也是一个有趣的副作用，你让我意识到了这一点，那就是，在建筑上种树就像是建筑界的前沿阵地。

sentences.en: And what they abandon in this is just putting trees on the ground where everyone can use them.
sentences.zh: 而他们在此过程中放弃的，仅仅是在地面上种植每个人都能使用的树木。

sentences.en: And what's also interesting is that it feels a little bit like architects jump the shark at some point.
sentences.zh: 同样有趣的是，这感觉有点像建筑师在某个时刻“跳过了鲨鱼”（指为了噱头而走极端）。

sentences.en: We used to have this idea of green roofs are good.
sentences.zh: 我们过去认为绿色屋顶是好的。

sentences.en: And green roofs are good.
sentences.zh: 绿色屋顶确实很好。

sentences.en: Often they're kind of thin layers of greenery and they serve certain functions like absorbing heat and converting oxygen.
sentences.zh: 它们通常是薄薄的一层绿植，起到吸收热量和转化氧气等特定功能。

sentences.en: And they don't take nearly as much work to make or maintain.
sentences.zh: 而且它们的建造或维护并不需要那么多工作。

sentences.en: It's just kind of this what's called extensive greenery, which is to say like sort of thin.
sentences.zh: 这只是所谓的“粗放型绿化”，也就是说，比较薄。

sentences.en: Mosses and grasses.
sentences.zh: 苔藓和草类。

sentences.en: Succulents.
sentences.zh: 多肉植物。

sentences.en: You don't really have to worry about it too much.
sentences.zh: 你真的不需要太担心它。

sentences.en: Like it more or less takes care of itself.
sentences.zh: 它或多或少能自我照料。

sentences.en: You might need some irrigation.
sentences.zh: 你可能需要一些灌溉。

sentences.en: The weight requirements are far reduced.
sentences.zh: 重量要求大大降低了。

sentences.en: And so it's like they started in this good place of saying like, well,
sentences.zh: 所以就像他们最初有一个很好的出发点，说，好吧，

sentences.en: let's add these layers of greenery and it will be a real benefit to the city and to the building and all these things.
sentences.zh: 让我们增加这些绿植层，这对城市、对建筑以及所有这些方面都将是一个真正的益处。

sentences.en: And it's super pleasant.
sentences.zh: 而且它超级令人愉悦。

sentences.en: Have you ever been in like a fancy office building that has a green roof?
sentences.zh: 你去过那种有绿色屋顶的高档办公楼吗？

sentences.en: It's great to have it on top there.
sentences.zh: 在上面有那个真的很棒。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I've seen really nice green walls like that too, sort of just kind of thin, not overdone.
sentences.zh: 我也见过非常漂亮的绿墙，也是那种薄薄的，没有过度设计。

sentences.en: And then at some point it's like the aesthetic just kind of took over and it's like, well, that's nice and all,
sentences.zh: 然后到了某个时刻，审美似乎占据了主导，就像是，好吧，那确实不错，

sentences.en: but it doesn't really look great in my drawing of this thing that I'm using to sell to like developers and whoever else.
sentences.zh: 但在我用来向开发商和其他人兜售的这个东西的图纸上，它看起来并不怎么出彩。

sentences.en: And then once you put one tree, you know, you got to put a whole forest up there.
sentences.zh: 然后一旦你放了一棵树，你知道，你就得在上面放一整片森林。

sentences.en: You got to have a whole vertical forest, right?
sentences.zh: 你得有一个完整的垂直森林，对吧？

sentences.en: But I'm really intrigued by this side effect of like the way to make your vertical skyscraper forest stand out is to take away all the trees at the base.
sentences.zh: 但我对这个副作用非常感兴趣，那就是让你的垂直摩天大楼森林脱颖而出的方法，竟然是移走底部的所有树木。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: And that's where it would do the most good and solve this problem that Sam has pointed out, the lack of equity when it comes to shade in places.
sentences.zh: 而那正是它能发挥最大作用、解决Sam指出的那个问题的地方，即在遮荫方面缺乏公平性。

sentences.en: And whereas I think the simple conclusion that we come to when it comes to the issue of shade in cities is more trees.
sentences.zh: 虽然我认为我们在城市遮荫问题上得出的简单结论是多植树。

sentences.en: But like most things, location, location, location is really important.
sentences.zh: 但像大多数事情一样，位置、位置、还是位置，这真的很重要。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And that's the thing.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: I would trust the intentions of these designers more if they were putting trees both on their buildings, but also all around their buildings and every available space.
sentences.zh: 如果这些设计师不仅在建筑上种树，而且在建筑周围和所有可用空间都种上树，我会更信任他们的初衷。

sentences.en: Because those are going to be the easiest to install or plant.
sentences.zh: 因为那些将是最容易安装或种植的。

sentences.en: They're going to be the easiest to take care of.
sentences.zh: 它们将是最容易照料的。

sentences.en: They're going to serve some public benefits potentially.
sentences.zh: 它们可能会带来一些公共利益。

sentences.en: Or even if you're in sort of a courtyard, at least they serve the community that is being built for.
sentences.zh: 或者即使你是在某种庭院里，至少它们服务于正在建设的社区。

sentences.en: And when they omit those trees on the ground and stack them all up high to make their building really stand out, it does.
sentences.zh: 而当他们省略了地面的树木，把它们全部堆在高处以使建筑脱颖而出时，确实如此。

sentences.en: It feels kind of like they're leaning into this almost anti-shade stance.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像他们倾向于这种近乎“反遮荫”的立场。

sentences.en: Like we are going to reserve the shade for these rich citizens who live here.
sentences.zh: 就像是我们要把遮荫留给住在这里的富人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We've privatized shade.
sentences.zh: 我们已经成功地将遮荫私有化了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We have successfully privatized shade.
sentences.zh: 我们已经成功地将遮荫私有化了。

sentences.en: And one of the things that I've dug into a little bit and I'm not an expert on, but one of the things that I've looked at is this question of how much good do these trees do?
sentences.zh: 我深入研究过的一件事，虽然我不是专家，但我看过的一个问题是，这些树木到底有多大作用？

sentences.en: Because it is good to add greenery to cities.
sentences.zh: 因为给城市增加绿植是好事。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: And by some rough math, so don't hold me to it.
sentences.zh: 根据一些粗略的计算，别太当真。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It looks like, for example, in one of these projects,
sentences.zh: 看起来，例如，在这些项目中的一个里，

sentences.en: the greenery that they've encased this giant building in offsets the effective carbon footprint of heating a half dozen homes for a year.
sentences.zh: 他们包裹在这栋巨大建筑上的绿植，抵消了六个家庭一年的供暖碳足迹。

sentences.en: And that's good, but it doesn't, you know, if you're thinking about carbon neutrality or even having something that's carbon negative,
sentences.zh: 这很好，但它并没有，你知道，如果你考虑碳中和，甚至拥有碳负排放的东西，

sentences.en: just installing those trees and creating all the structure for them might take up just as much carbon as they're offsetting.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是安装这些树木并为它们创造所有的结构，可能消耗的碳就和它们抵消的一样多。

sentences.en: And so the idea that if you clad your skyscraper in trees, it's going to actually make the building greener is going to be really context dependent.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你给摩天大楼穿上树木外衣，它就会让建筑变得更环保，这种想法是非常依赖于具体环境的。

sentences.en: It might someday in some cases, but in a lot of cases, it's offset by all the work you have to put into it in the first place.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，未来可能会实现，但在很多情况下，它被你首先必须投入的所有工作所抵消了。

sentences.en: Architects have good intentions in general, and I think architects tend to want to solve every problem they can, including problems that aren't within their purview, essentially.
sentences.zh: 建筑师总体上都有良好的初衷，我认为建筑师倾向于解决他们能解决的每一个问题，包括本质上不在他们职权范围内的问题。

sentences.en: Actually, I'm sure a lot of architects say to themselves, this is great.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我相信很多建筑师会对自己说，这太棒了。

sentences.en: I'm putting greenery up on buildings, and I just think it would be helpful if there was some more self-examination around the question of, you know,
sentences.zh: 我在建筑上种植绿植，我只是觉得如果能围绕这个问题进行更多的自我反思会很有帮助，你知道，

sentences.en: how is this going to work as a system beyond my particular building?
sentences.zh: 除了我这栋特定的建筑，它作为一个系统将如何运作？

sentences.en: It's great if you're providing habitats and shade and oxygen conversion on your building, but how is that going to interact with the city,
sentences.zh: 如果你能在建筑上提供栖息地、遮荫和氧气转化，那很好，但它将如何与城市互动，

sentences.en: and what is the net effect of what you're doing?
sentences.zh: 以及你所做之事的净效应是什么？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, I'm so glad that you made me aware of this.
sentences.zh: 好吧，很高兴你让我注意到了这一点。

sentences.en: And you wrote an article about this on the site a long time ago.
sentences.zh: 而且你很久以前就在网站上写过关于这件事的文章。

sentences.en: Yeah, I've written a few, and they're somewhat snarky in their headlines.
sentences.zh: 没错，我写过几篇，标题还有点尖酸刻薄。

sentences.en: I kind of have like a little axe to grind with this.
sentences.zh: 我对这件事多少有点个人意见。

sentences.en: A little call-out culture.
sentences.zh: 算是小小的公开批评文化吧。

sentences.en: Okay, that's cool.
sentences.zh: 好的，那很酷。
